message.content: {"note_claim":"Tristan Buckmaster alleges OpenAI built on his and Levent Alpöge’s related work after learning of it, while OpenAI denies using their work.","label":"SUPPORTS","quote":"Buckmaster claims that, last week, he learned that OpenAI had become aware of his and Alpöge’s work and had started putting significant resources toward the problem.","reason":"The page directly reports Buckmaster’s allegation and also says OpenAI executives denied inspecting their prompts or using their proof."}

parsed.note_claim: Tristan Buckmaster alleges OpenAI built on his and Levent Alpöge’s related work after learning of it, while OpenAI denies using their work.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Buckmaster claims that, last week, he learned that OpenAI had become aware of his and Alpöge’s work and had started putting significant resources toward the problem.
parsed.reason: The page directly reports Buckmaster’s allegation and also says OpenAI executives denied inspecting their prompts or using their proof.
